summary_1line: Kunti invokes Indra and gives birth to Arjuna, whose divine destiny is proclaimed as gods and sages celebrate his birth.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra descends in radiant splendor to Kunti in the forest hermitage to father the child who will be Arjuna.
A newborn Arjuna lies beside Kunti as a booming disembodied voice proclaims his future while flowers rain from the sky.
Gods, sages, Gandharvas, and Apsaras gather in the sky above the mountain hermitage, singing and dancing in celebration of Arjuna’s birth.
